subject: Decision Making
title: Automation Bias
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Automation Bias.

hook.text: Pilots followed GPS into a mountain because the computer told them to descend.

buildup.text: Automation bias is the tendency to over-rely on automated systems even when they produce obviously wrong outputs.

discovery.text: Studies show that when a computer and a human disagree, people side with the computer 70% of the time.

twist.text: Self-checkout registers, navigation apps, and spell-checkers all create small automation biases.

climax.text: As AI handles more decisions, automation bias will grow. Trusting the output without questioning the input is the new.

punchline.text: The computer said descend. They descended into a mountain. Trust, but verify.

quiz.question: What is automation bias?
options: The tendency to trust automated systems even when they produce incorrect outputs
